summary: Olivia Reed contacted HomeNet support because she wanted to set up automatic payments for her due dates to avoid missed payments. The agent verified the account and implemented autopay functionality, including sending email reminders before each payment charge. Olivia confirmed that the system now provides automated payment notifications.
